articles.headline: Lionel Messi in tears, future unclear after World Cup final loss
articles.description: Lionel Messi was left in tears after he was unable to conjure up one more piece of magic to save Argentina from defeat to Spain in Sunday's World Cup final at MetLife Stadium.

articles.headline: Luis de la Fuente's team ethos won the World Cup for Spain
articles.description: Luis de la Fuente's Spain lifted the 2026 FIFA World Cup through a series of performances that were the incarnate version of what your little league coach meant when he said, "there is no 'I' in team."

articles.headline: Messi didn't play well in World Cup final vs. Spain: So what? He's still the GOAT
articles.description: It's unlikely Messi will play in a World Cup final again, and although he disappointed against Spain, it will be forgotten due to his dazzling career.

articles.headline: Argentina's Scaloni exits press conference in tears: 'It hurts my soul'

articles.headline: Lionel Scaloni unsure about Argentina future: We will see
articles.description: Argentina manager Lionel Scaloni said he will need time to think about his future after his contract expires at the end of 2026.
